segments: And we are continuing with our program!
This is The First Radio, and your host is, as always, Max Golovnya...
I hope the song I just played reached the members of the expedition that set out to explore the Moscow Wasteland and went off the air just over a week ago.
I, for one, would like to believe there’s something wrong with their transmitter...
Look, we’re all worried, but...
In any case, hoping for the better is the most constructive thing we can do now, since panicking is definitely not going to help anyone.
We’re also not going to help anyone by setting out to rescue them, risking our lives in addition to theirs without proper preparation.
People, our train is on fire, and there is no lever to push.
People, this train is on fire, and there is no place left to run.
Oh, this land used to be ours, until we got lost on our track.
And this land - it will die if we leave it alone, it will die if we don’t claim it back!
And I can see torches, they’re gathered around, it’s assembly for all our dead troops.
And the people who used to shoot at our fathers, now have the same plans for our kids.
We all have been born to the sound of marches, we’ve all have been scared with jails.
And yet it is time to get up on our feet - for we’re home, we’re finally there!
Come on!..
Nnngh!..
Besides, my dear listeners, it looks like we’re already late for Moscow,
that ship has sailed about twenty years ago.
I might be wrong, of course, you know how I am with dates...
Actually, contrary to popular belief, it seems to me that the place wasn’t that great even before the War!
It might have actually gotten a bit better...
At least it’s quiet now...
Haha... khm... Yes... In any case, you shouldn’t go risking your life!
...with that excellent tune over, your tried and true host Max Golovnya is back in action!
You're listening to The First Radio, currently doubling as the only one in our area!
That automatically makes us the best I suppose!
Please... If anyone can hear me... Please, help!
Pa and uncle Kolya went for help... A week ago... And never came back...
There are monsters all around our basement now... At every window... And the planks won't hold long...
If anyone can hear me...
Aaaah! Help!
Run!
And I have seen generals, they gorge on our deaths,
Their children are dead inside ‘cause they’ve got all their wishes fulfilled.
While our land’s left to rust, and our churches all burned.
And if we want a place to call home, then I say it is time to return.
...Now, when we finally have the data on all of the largest city agglomerations,
it is obvious that our hopes to find one that had somehow been spared attack, were unfounded.
Moscow was, apparently, hit especially hard,
the new data confirms that fallout makes it completely impossible to live there.
Only Novosibirsk might be marginally worse, where...
Mommy, look at what I drew!
Hoho! Er, who is this?
It’s me! I drew this, look!
Oh, that’s a great picture!
Senior researcher Khakimova, please, take the child outside!
This is a briefing, after all.
Come, Giul... You can’t come in here, come, show me the picture outside...
While we’re waiting, I suggest we take a look at the enemy territory!
Here... And here...
This is, obviously, city lights! If not for "Directive 01”...
If we had any means of communication, we’d have to report the coordinates immediately as a target for the follow-up strikes...
Observation journal, new outpost. Important! Spotted the ex-captain, armed, heading East, hasn't noticed us, we updated the base and are waiting for the hunters.
What do we need them for?! He's getting away! We gotta act! Let's get him with a pincer movement, just the two of us is enough!
Tom said it clearly, we must wait for the hunters.
Tom, always Tom! Soon you won't know to wipe your ass unless he gives you the order to! He didn't put everything exactly!
We should have called Klim, he'd give us sane orders, not like that windbag with his crap!
Yeah, your darling Klim would have told you: "Get him or I'll have your head", end of story!
The Captain isn't your average Joe, what would you do if he gave us the slip?
You're just a coward, that's all, you and your Tom. You must take risks if you want to achieve anything!
Yeah, right... Explain to me then, why does Klim work for Tom then, and why do you work for me?
We'll see about that...
You'll see?! Watch the Captan, you idiot! I'll fuck you up if you lose him... "We'll see about that"!
Now I wasted a tape because of you!
As for the rest of Russia, all we know is that, for the most part, it still exists.
There are also people living in some places, apparently.
Botanical Gardens station, August fourteenth...
Don’t you have anything better to do than mess with that thing, Mikhalych?
Oh, am I bothering you? We can’t do anything without the welding burner, and this way I can at least make a record...
(monster’s howl)
Ha! Did you hear that?
Of course I did! I’m about to go deaf from their howling! Why do you want them recorded?
I heard the Polis people are studying these - migration patterns and what not...
So, they are buying records and stuff, but they have to be taken properly, with date and place and all the...
Oh, they’ll get the date and place this time correct, they’ll read it on your gravestone! Forget this thing!
Mikhalych! Get over here! They’re attacking again!
Coming!
We totally blew it... I hope, at least Sasha got away...
They rushed us, filled the whole tunnel... It was down to grenades and knives in the end...
Then Mikhalych blew the gas cylinders up...
Howling again... I think, that’s it...
Hmm... Yes... You see, I just took a glance at my watch...
It is almost time we had a break in our broadcast to recharge the batteries.
But I don’t really like ending our program on this sad note, so...
A little bit of music to pick us up!
Good...
With that, my dear listeners, I have to bid you farewell until the end of our technical break.
You’ve been listening to The First Radio, and the man ranting here was your one and only host, Max Golovnya!
Good luck everyone! Don’t forget to dress according to the radiation! It is Spring, after all!
...the AI-2000 medkit and VF-P field medic kits include another product of our Institute’s research:
the RENERGAN-F vesicant effect suppressor - regeneration stimulant combination,
providing quick remedy for the consequences of vesicant agent exposure and ensuring rapid recovery of damaged tissue, particularly lung tissue.
Clinical tests have confirmed pronounced therapeutic effect produced by a single application,
and a complete treatment course ensures complete recovery in 60 percent of even the most severe cases, with partial recovery in...
Damn…
You're heavy!
Thank you, Sam...
But it is not. We have to get them all!
Spread out!
As one would expect of early Spring, we're currently seeing some South-Eastern gusty winds.
And, as it's been the case for the past twenty years, these winds are bringing...
...Drumroll!
No, not pleasant smells and good mood, but radioactive dust from the Moscow Wasteland!
So if you’re going out it would be a good idea to dress according to the weather:
a gas mask or full protective gear makes for a nice choice.
If you decide to be risky, within a mere hour you could catch a cold and something around... two by four point five...
Around seventy or so microsieverts, which is nothing to sneeze at in my book!
So, I urge you to exercise precaution, my dear listeners...
Of course, if any of you are still tuned in after hearing such ground-breaking scientific insights, haha!
Shit...
breathe!
Mikhail? Fedorov from the Section Twenty here...
Look... Our filters here are complete trash, and on Sibirskaya they were replaced this autumn...
Could you let my kids stay at your station? People from their school are there, too...
I can't, Nikitich... The military are in charge here now, they don't let anyone in...
But don't worry, they're going to start handing the radioprotector out!
Am I supposed to give that green shit to my kids?
Don't give me that! The green stuff is better than any filters you could get! As I said, don't worry!
You'll just have to take it for a couple of months until the situation gets better...
Anyhow, let’s talk about this later.
OK... Let's do that...
Good.
People, our train is on fire, and there is no lever to push.
People, this train is on fire, and there is no place left to run.
Oh, this land used to be ours, until we got lost on our track.
And this land - it will die if we leave it alone, it will die if we don’t claim it back!
People, our train is on fire, and there is no lever to push.
People, this train is on fire, and there is no place left to run.
Oh, this land used to be ours, until we got lost on our track.
And this land - it will die if we leave it alone, it will die if we don’t claim it back.
Liubochka...
(song starts)
(song interrupts with a new recording)
Man, this is bullshit... It don't play shit...
Are you pushing the right buttons?
Do you think I'm a fucking idiot or what? These fucktards just went and messed with the fucking thing...
Why the fuck did they even have that? Hey, you, asshole, why did you have it with you? You aren't supposed to touch things like this!
We were taking the satanic contraption to the House of the Tsar-Fish for purification and protection from it...
To the fucking terminal? Damn, you're fucked up... To throw such a great thing out... Hear that, Tolyan?
I fucking did... The thing ought to be trashed though... See, it spins the tape, but don't play fuck... Could it be the batteries? Hey you, do you fucks have fresh batteries?
No! Electricity is a sin! Ungodly technology is a sin!
Shut the fuck up you piece of shit!
Uugh...
Maybe, like this... Fuck me if I know... Looks like this is doing nothing... Should we just swap it for something good with the boys? It does spin the tape and all...
Ah, who the fuck wants a broken piece of shit... Fuck it!
(song resumes)
(song ends)
By the way, I often get asked about why I am so fond of that record to the point I broadcast it all the time.
Here’s the reply, my dear listeners, and it’s actually quite simple!
First, I really do like that record.
And, second, I don’t have any others at the moment! Haha!
Well, we are probably going to discuss the problem of extending my choice of records at a later date, since now we have other matters to attend to.
When Colonel Vasin arrived at front lines, he also brought his young wife.
Then Colonel Vasin addressed his troops and said: brothers, it's time go home!
This war we kept fighting for seventy years, the war we’ve been told was our life
That war, I believe the intelligence says, we fought it against our own selves!
This is my last tape, so I have to make it last...
September 20th
Tonight we had a... preacher barge into the Council meeting to spout some bullshit about
God having spared us specifically and then sending the ball lightning to punish us for our sins... Sins?
What was he even talking about?!
Our last generator is out because of those things, people died!
He didn’t stop at sins, he went on to say that we are to fight the demons of electricity with prayer, fasting and charms!
Charms?! And those idiots actually listened to him!
Luckily, Roman had enough sense to kick the madman out, or else I would have blown my fuse...
Anyway, due to those idiotic ramblings we’ve agreed to delay
the construction of the lightning rod stockade a bit, let the madman show his charms in action...
September 27th
That Silantius isn’t as dumb as he seems...
Those "charms” of his were actually lightning rods!
It took so long for our electricians to explain proper grounding, and the people
still think they can cheat physics,
but this guy just told them God ordered to do it this way, and what do you know?
They destroyed three of those ball lightning things yesterday, with no losses!
Roman was unhappy, though... There’s no pleasing some people...
hat difference does the color of a cat make as long as the cat catches the rats?
October 5th
Silantius is right, we have to get rid of the rest of the equipment,
it does attract the ball lightning, and it’s not like we are
ever going to restore the normal supply of electricity without our generator.
So, what’s the point in taking a risk by keeping the stuff? We can live without it...
October 7th
Roman is dead... That catfish...
Yes, there was no real need to gather everyone, we could have gone through it gradually...
And it is true that some of the actual useful stuff got thrown into the river, too - but such things are bound to happen...
It’s hardly worth starting a commotion over and jumping into the water!
He definitely could feel the power seeping through his fingers, but to go so far as to raise a hand against Silantius?
And it happened exactly the way the man told us it would, too...
December 31st
The tape is coming to an end, just as this year...
God willing, our troubles are going to end with it, too...
We’re no longer alone in this world, the God is with us, so who could stand against us?
Not me, that’s for sure...
This means, this log is done for...
A New Year’s Eve is a perfect time to turn a new page. Besides, as Father Silantius says, electricity is a sin...
As you have probably already surmised, my dear listeners,
the bread of a weatherman is especially hard and salty with sweat and tears nowadays,
for communications leave a lot to be desired.
Still, there are some causes for cautious optimism here!
Fifteen years ago, there was NOTHING on the air, nothing as in ZIP, NADA...
And now there are stations popping up in places you’d never believe!
A mere two days ago we received a transmission from the freaking Faroe Islands, for Chrissake!
And I’m not even lying!
Now, who wants to touch me? Hahaha! In any case...
The moral here is that there’s still life on our old Earth, and it looks like we are going to stay here for a while longer, after all...
What an enormous beast!
So, let us heed the Council’s warning and do as we’re advised, let us not go there.
Neither alone, nor in groups.
Let us not go there at all!
No driving there, either.
I’d even advise against approaching the place!
‘Cause nobody knows what is going on there.
It is highly doubtful that anyone would survive there, and even if someone did...
I don’t really think their life is anything like... Life.
At least, judging by the sheer amount of radioactive shit the winds are still bringing from there...
Kirill...
This is it!
I found it!
Hello again, my dear listeners! You are tuned to The First Radio and, as usual, the man at the mic is Max Golovnya!
We are together and on the air again! So, to kick off our present session, let’s start with some music!
But let’s wrap up this sidetrack and get back to weather...
I completely neglected to report the most important piece of information I have in that regard...
The one you’re all so eager to know!
So, here goes nothing...
The thermometer outside of the studio’s window currently says it’s six degrees below zero,
which is an outright luxury for Vyshny Volochyok, all things considered.
It seems that the nuclear spring that’s been hinted at since forever by every optimistically-inclined forecast enthusiast out there, has finally arrived!
